lemma tapes (G : Gauge) (hG : G.Simple) (P : Teller G) (Q : ConnectedActivityE6.Target G P) (p L) {n : ℕ} (M : Record) (C : Libretto G n) (W c ε v : ℝ) (o : ConnectedActivityE6.Target.Order G W) (m : ℕ) (κ : Chi)
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hM : M.ε≤1/4) (hc : 0<c) (ht : v / (L:Side).val ≤ c) (he : 0 ≤ ε) : ∀ᶠ s in atTop, Verandah Q o M C ε v m p κ L s c := by
  by_cases h : ∃ t : Patch,t.L=L ∧ t.J=P.j ∧ t.Branches P.bind G
  swap; · exact Eventually.of_forall fun s c f S T hh=> (h ⟨S.patch,hh.length_eq,hh.funds.atStep,hh.funds.kernel⟩).elim
  obtain ⟨D,h,hF,h'⟩:= h
  obtain ⟨X,hX,H⟩:= Brim.pressings G hG P L D h' p n C M hM hn Chi.canonical κ W o ε m he
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0:ℝ),H,hX.below (by norm_num) _ hc] with x hx hh hE c' f S T hs R μ α H B hb hp hW hA hf hh' hu j hj C' d v' Y A b r B₀ q k N q' ε'
  obtain ⟨⟨z,hz,hZ⟩,z',hz',hZ'⟩:=hh c' f S T (hs.patch h hF) hs R Q μ α H B hb hp hW hA v hf hh' hu _ hj A b d Y C' B₀ r v' q k N q' ε' -- field order!
  have hp : 0 ≤ incomingE G L x := Real.rpow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) _
  have hy : incomingE G L x ≤ δE x := Real.rpow_le_rpow (inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
    (inv_anti₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hx) (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (le_add_of_nonneg_right (YM.Work.E04.shift_nonneg G L)))) (by norm_num)
  exact ⟨⟨z,hz, fun i=>budget_loosen (hZ i) ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht hp).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy hc.le))⟩,
    z',fun i=>budget_loosen (hz' i) ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hE hp).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy hc.le)),hZ'⟩

proof_context.conclusion: Given v/L <= c (the side fixed by wantFacet/faceting), eventually in the coupling the inherited-term record Brim.Houses holds with principal budget and comparison residual both bounded by c*deltaE.
